name: window-sidecar-listen-register
description: The page registers the first listener of the session tab-a of the sidecar @x/side with the host and receives its messages until the registration is applied; the page then removes the registration when its last listener ends.
reason: The case delivers sidecar-message notices to the page, and the Go producer runs no window to receive a notice (docs/spec/cases/page-wire/README.md#producer-runs).
